posts.text: Happy Earth Day and welcome to the world and zoo Lin Mai 🐘🌎🍃#earthday #smithsonian

I was joined by @Dr. Arthur Brooks on my podcast and he shared what HIS case for America is. Be sure to click the link in my bio and share yours to win a signed copy of my new book #caseforamerica #america250

“I don’t think that’s anybody’s idea of fairness,” says Brit Hume after a Virginia court ruled a redistricting referendum unconstitutional, blocking a map that would have shifted the state’s representation to a 10-1 Democratic shift #virginia #specialreport
Tim Shriver, CEO of UNITE, joins Common Ground revealing that 83% of Americans view political divisiveness as an urgent problem only second to affordability #commonground

My new book The Case For America comes out May 5th. Be sure to record YOUR case for America by clicking the link in my bio or comment here. I will send my favorite 100 video entries a signed copy of the book! #caseforamerica #america250
Leaders here in Washington emphasize the importance of debating critical national security policy with personal respect and integrity #commonground #congress

On tonight’s Common Ground lawmakers debate the strategic impact of China’s leverage over Iranian oil and critical minerals as the U.S. balances military presence in the Strait of Hormuz #commonground #straitofhormuz #china
FBI Director Kash Patel is suing The Atlantic for defamation over an article alleging mismanagement and drinking, though the publication maintains they stand by their reporting #specialreport
What a week it was, thank you for tuning in #specialreport
